name: Solstice upgrade
notes: NV29 upgrade (Solstice) that deprecates Filecoin Plus and funds a service economy: all new sectors receive 10x QAP regardless of content, legacy 1x sectors are lifted through SnapDeals or UpgradeSectorQuality, and each block reward is split into service (w2, Filecoin Pay volume-gated), consensus (w1, ramping 95% to 50%) and burn (w0, residual) streams governed by the new SWA and SRA contracts. Mainnet upgrade epoch 6470279 (2026-10-19T12:59:30Z); calibnet has already upgraded at epoch 4109133.
